description: This file defines the SSLContextCreator class, which constructs SSLContext instances based on provided connection credentials, trust managers, and hostname verification policies. It includes methods for creating SSL contexts with specific trust managers, client certificates, or trusting all certificates, primarily used for establishing secure SSL/TLS connections.

classes.name: SSLContextCreator
classes.description: A factory class that creates SSLContext instances configured according to provided trust managers, client certificates, hostname verification, and other SSL settings based on connection credentials.

methods.name: withTrustManager
methods.description: Static factory method to create an SSLContextCreator with a preconfigured TrustManager.

methods.name: fromConnection
methods.description: Static factory method to create SSLContextCreator based on a Connection object, configuring certificate validation and trust accordingly.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an SSLContextCreator with specified trusted certificates, headers, hostname, and connection logger.

methods.name: clientCertificate
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext with a client certificate based on provided credentials.

methods.name: withoutClientCertificate
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext without a client certificate, trusting only the server.

methods.name: newTLSContext
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate an SSLContext with specified key managers and trust managers.
